content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler interface artifact for boundary_condition_module, generated from exchange_gpu.f90. It records CUDA/NVIDIA/cuTENSOR/reduction dependencies, private FUNWAVE module dependencies, imported grid and physics switches, many mod_cuda device arrays, GPU boundary kernels, flux and dispersion exchange procedures, generic field-collection procedures, periodic north-south exchange, and extensive compiler type/symbol/argument tables (lines 1-1254).
entities: boundary_condition_module compiler-interface artifact generated from exchange_gpu.f90 (lines 1-2, 57)
Public indirect dependencies: iso_c_binding, nvf_acc_common, cuda_runtime_api, cutensor_v2_types, cutensor_v2, cutensorex_types, gpu_reduc_types, gpu_reductions, and sort (lines 4-12)
Private dependencies on mod_cuda, global, and param (lines 14-16)
Imported param symbols grav, zero, and sp (lines 58-60)

Grid bounds/dimensions and boundary switches: ibeg/iend/iend1, jbeg/jend/jend1, mloc/nloc/mloc1/nloc1, nghost, periodic, viscosity_breaking, wavemaker_vis, diffusion_sponge, disp_time_left, gamma2, gamma3, and wavemaker (lines 61-79)
mod_cuda device fields for masks, fluxes, eta, depths, breaking, velocities, momenta, spatial/time derivatives, and boundary counts (lines 80-147, 354-446)
